purpose: Freeze the complete successful pre-unblind DEM morphometry output by immutable content hash before any INGEMMET A6680 numeric morphometry is read.
hash_rule: SHA256 is computed over the exact report bytes downloaded from the successful GitHub Actions artifact; do not parse and reserialize before hashing.
immutability_rule: Once committed, a freeze record for this phase-1 report SHA256 is append-only provenance. Any replacement phase-1 result requires a new freeze record and an explicit scientific reason; the prior record is not overwritten.

a6680_numeric_morphometry_may_be_opened_: freeze record validates all anti-leakage guards
forbidden_before_gate: read A6680 numeric basin area, channel length, drainage density, slope or other morphometry
change DEM reconstruction, conditioning, slope algorithm, channel threshold or metric inclusion rule
select a phase-1 run because its metrics agree better with A6680
